This confirmation applies only to this send. It does not create or change authorization rules.
Helix runs tasks on this device and stores sessions and settings locally, without cloud sync. Models may process requests through services you configure.
The conversation shows the selected model service, destination and data residence. Tools may also contact external services you enable.
Configure credentials in dedicated settings or Runtime sign-in screens. Avoid putting keys, passwords or tokens in conversations. Recognizable credential content is checked before sending.
Standard is the default. You choose capabilities and file scopes; actions requiring approval show their details for your review. Switching modes does not grant permission.
Workspace, SAF and the file manager land in M4.
The controlled WebView browser and Browser Tools land in M6.
Manage installed Skills and Connector endpoints.
System capabilities, approvals and the advanced-permissions entry land in their milestones.
Model Provider and local settings land in M2.
Tool-execution audit records land in M3.

M2 note: switching to Advanced enables no new capability — zero permission requests, zero Runtime installs, zero Root sessions, zero new network endpoints. Each advanced capability is enabled by its own later milestone, scoped and immediately revocable.
This build uses Standard and has no Advanced switch. Available capabilities are listed in its settings.

Switching to Advanced itself grants no capability: it requests no system permission, installs no Runtime, requests no Root, connects to no new network endpoint, and widens no available tools.

Advanced opens controlled advanced capabilities (All-files, Accessibility, offline PRoot, Root, precise LAN origin, and so on). Each capability remains off by default, must be enabled and scoped by the user, and can be revoked immediately.

The shared security core is unchanged: the model cannot self-authorize; schema validation, Policy, per-use approval, audit and revocation rules are never disabled or downgraded under Advanced.
